minimum_safe_summary: This paper investigates the integration of biomimetic design and virtual reality technology to enhance commercial exhibition space design, leveraging biotechnological insights. The study explores cell-like and emotional biomimetic design methods, aiming to create engaging, intuitive, and immersive experiences. Quantitative results indicate that the bionic virtual design achieved an average environmental adaptability score of 1.63 and an environmental authenticity score of 0.75, with 85.5% of participants providing positive evaluations of the overall environment. These findings suggest the effectiveness of this integrated approach in creating dynamic and engaging commercial exhibition spaces. No specific limitations were stated in the provided text.
